{{/* Quartz Beer-source: Beer → Atmosphere fonts → layout → Cap CSS → variant (last wins density). Default seed/preset from beerSeed / beerPreset; bundled character via characterRef. Use index for mdfriday — core errors on missing nested fields. */}} {{- $beer := partial "beer-cdn.html" . | strings.TrimSpace -}} {{- $mdf := index .Site.Params "mdfriday" | default dict -}} {{- $seed := index $mdf "beerSeed" | default "#3366cc" -}} {{- $preset := index $mdf "beerPreset" | default "vector" -}} {{- if not $seed -}}{{- $seed = "#3366cc" -}}{{- end -}} {{- if not $preset -}}{{- $preset = "vector" -}}{{- end -}} {{- $trim := "\n\r\t " -}} {{/* Variant last so TOC/nav density overrides Cap defaults */}}
